lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 17 — In Thessalonica, Berea and Athens

questions.questionText: When Paul and Silas had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to where?
For how many Sabbaths did Paul reason with them from the Scriptures?
Paul explained the Messiah had to suffer and rise. Who did he say the Messiah is?
options: This Jesus I am proclaiming to you

questions.questionText: Some Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of whom?
options: God-fearing Greeks and quite a few prominent women

questions.questionText: Other Jews were jealous and rounded up whom?
options: Some bad characters from the marketplace

questions.questionText: They rushed to whose house looking for Paul and Silas?
They shouted these men have caused trouble all over the world. Whom did they drag?
They said the believers claim there is another king. Who?
After Jason posted bond, what did the brothers do at night?
options: Sent Paul and Silas away to Berea

questions.questionText: How were the Berean Jews different?
options: They were of more noble character and examined the Scriptures every day

questions.questionText: As a result, many of them believed, as did also a number of whom?
options: Prominent Greek women and many Greek men

questions.questionText: When Thessalonian Jews learned Paul was preaching in Berea, what did they do?
options: They went there too, agitating the crowds

questions.questionText: The believers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy did what?
Those who escorted Paul brought him to where?
While Paul was waiting in Athens he was greatly distressed to see what?
options: That the city was full of idols

questions.questionText: He reasoned in the synagogue and in the marketplace. Which philosophers disputed with him?
Some said he seems to be advocating foreign gods. They said this because he was preaching what?
They took him to which meeting place?
Paul said, People of Athens! I see that in every way you are very what?
Paul found an altar with which inscription?
Paul said the God who made the world does not live in what?
From one man God made all the nations. He marked out their what?
options: Appointed times in history and the boundaries of their lands

questions.questionText: Paul quoted, For in him we live and move and have our _____.
Paul said God now commands all people everywhere to do what?
God has set a day to judge the world by the man he has appointed. He has given proof how?
options: By raising him from the dead

questions.questionText: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some of them what?
I am a member of the Areopagus who believed. Who am I?
I also believed, a woman named what?
True or false: A few people became followers of Paul and believed in Athens.
Officials made me post bond. Who am I?
Paul sent for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible from which city?
True or false: Bereans examined the Scriptures every day to see if what Paul said was true.
options: True — but only once a year

questions.questionText: Who formed a mob and started a riot in Thessalonica?
options: Jealous Jews with bad characters from the marketplace

questions.questionText: Paul walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship in which city?
God is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything. Rather he gives everyone life and _____ and everything else.
True or false: Paul said we should not think God is like gold or silver or stone.
options: False — he said make more idols

questions.questionText: Who escorted Paul to the coast from Berea?
There was a Jewish synagogue in which first city of this chapter?
I am a prominent woman of Berea who believed. What group am I part of?
Some said Paul was a babbler. Others said he seems to be advocating what?
